title: Border Patrol Agents Aid Injured Driver After Vehicle Rollover
excerpt: U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector agents assisted local law enforcement after a vehicle rollover, giving immediate aid to the injured driver.
content:
U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector agents assisted local law enforcement after a vehicle rollover, giving immediate aid to the injured driver.

The sector shared the update Monday morning, Nov. 23. Agents helped at the scene and coordinated with EMS, fire and state law enforcement partners.

The sector said it is proud to work together with law enforcement and first responder partners to keep communities safe.

Source: U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector.
